prompt: I'm building a SwiftUI iOS app (iOS 16+) with The Composable Architecture (TCA). I need a feature that shows a paginated list of products fetched from a REST API, supports pull-to-refresh, handles errors gracefully with a retry button, and stores the last successful response in CoreData so the list is available offline. Show me the TCA feature structure and the full implementation.

assertions.name: includes-architectural-blueprint
assertions.description: Prose Architectural Blueprint section present before code

assertions.name: handles-offline-with-coredata
assertions.description: CoreData (or SwiftData) is used for offline persistence

assertions.name: no-todo-placeholders
assertions.description: No // TODO or placeholder comments in Swift code

assertions.name: includes-architectural-verification
assertions.description: Architectural Verification bullets at the end covering edge cases
